description: This file defines the CalendarWritePlatformService interface, which declares methods for creating, updating, and deleting calendars and calendar instances within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: CalendarWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for calendar write operations such as creating, updating, and deleting calendars and their instances.

methods.name: createCalendar
methods.description: Creates a new calendar using the details provided in the JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateCalendar
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteCalendar
methods.description: Deletes the calendar identified by the given calendarId.

methods.name: createCalendarInstance
methods.description: Creates a calendar instance associated with a specific entity.

methods.name: updateCalendarInstance
methods.description: Updates a calendar instance for a specific entity.
